title: Correct remaining PR-003 null-item and wildcard-ownership defects
objective: Finish the two independently reproduced PR003 null-item rejection and wildcard ownership defects with additive evidence.
outcome: The PR-003 checker returns schema-invalid rejected reports for null or non-object collection items without throwing, and honors documented slash-aware * / ** owned-path globs including an interior globstar with no intervening directory.

commits.verification: Focused tests cover the six failing collections, malformed non-object elements, a valid-packet control, direct matcher cases, and completed-packet wildcard scope; named semantic diagnostics for structurally safe incomplete packets remain.
